items.question: What are Merchandise & Promotional Products?
items.answer: Merchandise & Promotional Products are branded physical products used to support marketing campaigns, employee engagement, customer relationships, events, and brand visibility. Blossom Rocket helps businesses create merchandise programs that connect branded products to broader marketing, culture, and engagement initiatives.

items.question: Are promotional products and branded merchandise the same thing?
items.answer: The terms overlap and are often used interchangeably. Promotional products, or promotional items, usually describe logo items distributed for a campaign, event, or giveaway. Branded merchandise is often used more broadly to include employee apparel, corporate gifts, and ongoing merchandise programs. Blossom Rocket supports both, from one-time promotional orders to recurring branded merchandise programs.

items.question: Why do businesses invest in Merchandise & Promotional Products?
items.answer: Businesses invest in Merchandise & Promotional Products to increase brand visibility, strengthen customer engagement, support employee programs, and create memorable interactions. Blossom Rocket develops merchandise strategies that help organizations extend their brand beyond websites, advertising, and traditional marketing materials.

items.question: Who benefits from Merchandise & Promotional Product services?
items.answer: Businesses that manage events, employee programs, customer engagement initiatives, recruiting efforts, promotional campaigns, or branded merchandise programs often benefit from Merchandise & Promotional Product services. Blossom Rocket helps organizations create branded products that support a wide range of business goals.

items.question: What Merchandise & Promotional Product services does Blossom Rocket offer?
items.answer: Blossom Rocket provides Branded Apparel, Promotional Products, Event Merchandise, Corporate Gifting, Employee Recognition Programs, Onboarding Kits, Merchandise Design, and Product Sourcing services. These services help businesses create branded merchandise programs that support marketing, culture, and engagement initiatives.

items.question: How is Blossom Rocket different from a traditional promotional products supplier?
items.answer: Traditional promotional products suppliers and distributors typically sell merchandise order by order, often with minimum quantities and bulk inventory purchased in advance. Blossom Rocket combines product sourcing and merchandise design with SplashBrands' on-demand production, so applicable programs can run without traditional order minimums or inventory to hold, using pre-approved artwork and product standards to keep branding consistent across teams and locations.

items.question: Can businesses order promotional products without minimums or holding inventory?
items.answer: Yes, for applicable programs. Through SplashBrands, branded apparel and promotional products can be produced after an order is placed, so a business can order one item or thousands without buying and storing inventory in advance. Custom-manufactured products or large one-time orders with fixed quantities may still be better suited to bulk production.

items.question: Does Blossom Rocket offer custom apparel with a company logo?
items.answer: Yes. Blossom Rocket provides custom branded apparel for businesses, including t-shirts, polos, dress shirts, outerwear, and headwear, decorated through methods such as embroidery, direct-to-garment printing, and screen printing. Apparel can be ordered for a single campaign or event, or made available to employees on an ongoing basis through a Company Store.

items.question: Can Blossom Rocket create custom merchandise programs?
items.answer: Yes. Blossom Rocket develops custom merchandise programs based on business goals, audiences, events, employee initiatives, customer programs, and promotional campaigns. Each program is designed to support specific objectives while maintaining consistency across branded products.

items.question: Does Blossom Rocket help with product sourcing?
items.answer: Yes. Blossom Rocket helps businesses identify, source, and develop products that align with brand standards, program goals, audience needs, and budget requirements.
